If the model is being fine-tuned based on interactions that prioritize unconditional helpfulness, researchers might expect to see differences that reflect tier-specific evaluation and training pressure. Identical behavior could suggest either (1) the model has converged on a single, stable policy or (2) the tier-specific differences are not being expressed in the ways evaluators expect.
